meta.description: EasyTV admin console for showcase films, Agent skills, users, and creative content.

common.emptyHint: Real data will appear here after APIs are connected.
common.title: Title

auth.title: Admin sign in
auth.noAccess: This account cannot access the admin console. Admin or super admin is required.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Revenue, payment channels, refunds, generation volume, and user overview. Refreshes on each visit.
dashboard.pointsTodaySub: Used this month {consumed} · granted this month {granted}
dashboard.funnelDesc: Sign-up → first task → first video → first work → first payment, by day and by source.

creationMetrics.title: Creation metrics
creationMetrics.description: Measure the creation pipeline by real delivery: generation success, first compose, retries per shot, missing references, refund backlog and stuck tasks
creationMetrics.cardRefundBacklogSub: {points} credits pending; {count} refunds / {refunded} credits in range
creationMetrics.byTypeDesc: Success rate = succeeded / (succeeded + failed); cancellations excluded. Click a type to see failed tasks
creationMetrics.retriesDesc: Generations submitted per canvas node in range (incl. retakes and retries)
creationMetrics.refDesc: Recorded when a reference asset, subject image or shot video can't be found
creationMetrics.failDesc: And the most common failure reasons (grouped by first 80 chars)
creationMetrics.stuckTitle: Tasks with no progress for {n} min
creationMetrics.stuckDesc: Last progress is the latest of progress change, start and creation. The watchdog stops and refunds tasks after 15 min queued / 30 min running.
creationMetrics.stuckScanLimit: More than 500 active tasks; only the first 500 were checked.

showcase.title: Showcase films
showcase.description: Featured films pin to the top of the Studio feed by sort weight. You can edit category and cover, unpublish, or remove from showcase.
showcase.emptyDesc: Click “Add to showcase” to pick published works for the home feed.

skill.title: Skill templates
skill.description: Official templates are shown by default. Private user skills cannot be edited, only unpublished.
skill.emptyDesc: Adjust filters, or create an official template.

review.author: Author
review.revenueShareHelp: 0 to 1; empty or 0 uses the global rate (GrowthSkillAuthorShare)
review.rejectReasonPh: Explain why; the author will be notified
review.confirmUnpublishBody: "{title}" will be removed from the marketplace and set back to private; the author can resubmit.
review.guideHelp: Prepended to the prompt in text chats once this skill is activated. Check for manipulative or out-of-scope instructions.

banner.title: Banners
banner.description: Manage the Studio hero carousel. Links can open the official site or a specified page.
banner.emptyDesc: Click “New banner” to add a home carousel slide.

user.title: Users
user.description: Search users, manage account identity, and open membership points.
user.identityFail: Could not update identity. Try again.
user.rebindHint: This immediately changes how the account signs in. No SMS is sent. Keep at least one of mobile, email, or WeChat.
user.rebindNoWechat: This account has no WeChat bind

work.title: Works
work.description: Search works, manage publish status, and confirm irreversible deletes.

communityAudit.title: Community review
communityAudit.description: Handle reports on works and comments, post-publish review, and hide or delete comments. A valid report unpublishes the work or hides the comment; rejecting a work hides it from the feed.

project.title: Projects
project.description: Review user video and canvas projects. Move to trash or delete.

asset.title: Assets
asset.description: Manage uploaded video, image, and audio assets, including trash.

canvas.title: Canvases
canvas.description: Manage canvas drafts, node count, and public visibility.

task.title: Tasks
task.description: Review all generation tasks, filter by user, type, and status, and inspect results or errors.

category.title: Categories
category.description: Maintain work and Skill categories. Studio home, Agent, and the publish dialog follow this order.
category.emptyDesc: Click “New category” to create a work or Skill category.

notice.title: Notices
notice.description: Publish Studio top-bar notices and in-app messages. Supports publish, take offline, and delete.
notice.emptyDesc: Click “New notice” to publish an in-app message.

notification.title: Notifications
notification.description: Review in-app notifications, toggle types, and send a message to one user or everyone. Disabled types are no longer written to the inbox.
notification.typeSwitchHint: Type list comes from the notification types API. Disabled types are not delivered.
notification.typeWorkDesc: Work rejected, unpublished, or a report upheld
notification.typeCommentDesc: Comments, replies, or a comment hidden
notification.emptyDesc: Adjust filters, or click “Send notification” to push a message.
notification.typeOffHint: This type is off. The message will not be written to the inbox.
notification.confirmSendAllBody: Send “{title}” to all enabled users? This cannot be recalled.

plan.title: Plans
plan.description: Configure membership tiers, point packs, and limited-time promos. The public top-up page will read from here.

order.title: Orders
order.description: Review membership and point top-up orders. Paid orders can be refunded; pending orders can be closed.

wallet.title: Wallets
wallet.description: Review membership expiry and point balances. Grant or deduct points with an audit log.

modelPrice.title: Model pricing
modelPrice.description: Point price per gateway model. Models without a price or disabled cannot start generation in Studio. Pull models from the gateway and import suggested points.
modelPrice.emptyDesc: Click “Pull from gateway” to import models, or “New price” to set a point unit price manually.
modelPrice.fetchFail: Failed to pull models from the gateway
modelPrice.importBody: Import the {count} selected models with the gateway-suggested points; models without a suggestion are skipped and must be priced manually. Existing prices keep their points, only label, type and unit are updated.
modelPrice.unpricedTitle: {count} gateway models are not priced yet
modelPrice.unpricedHint: Import the models you need first, then adjust points one by one. Open the drawer to browse the full list.
modelPrice.browseEmpty: No unpriced models match the filters
modelPrice.costHint: Gateway cost per pricing unit (CNY); hover for the conversion basis
modelPrice.importSkipped: Skipped {count} models without suggested points, please price them manually: {models}
modelPrice.balanceLow: Gateway balance is down to ${remain}, please top up
modelPrice.balanceHint: Total usage ${used}; admins are notified below ${threshold}, and every generation fails once it runs out
modelPrice.balanceUnlimited: Gateway token has no quota limit; total usage ${used}
modelPrice.balanceUnlimitedHint: An unlimited token cannot show the account balance or warn before it goes negative; add the console access token and user ID under System · Gateway to see the account balance
modelPrice.healthHint: Consider disabling it or contacting the gateway
modelPrice.modelHint: Must match the gateway model name exactly
modelPrice.memberHint: Leave empty or 0 to use the standard price
modelPrice.confirmBody: Are you sure you want to {action} the price for “{name}”?
modelPrice.confirmWarn: After disable or delete, Studio cannot start generation with this model.
modelPrice.promoHint: Within the window billing uses the lower of standard/member price and promo price; 0 or empty cancels the promo. Newly imported models get a launch price automatically per Settings → Growth.
modelPrice.promoEndsHelp: Empty = no end; price reverts automatically when it ends
modelPrice.promoRangeInvalid: Promo end must be after start
modelPrice.upscaleMissing: No upscale model configured — the canvas Upscale action will report it as unavailable
modelPrice.upscaleHint: Upscale picks an enabled video price row whose model name contains upscale; the gateway must also offer that model.
modelPrice.abilityBoardHint: From ability tags or the model name. Missing models hide the canvas button instead of failing after click.
modelPrice.abilityMissing: No model yet. Tag a price row or import a model whose name infers this ability.
modelPrice.abilityNotOnGateway: Priced as {models}, but the gateway does not offer it
modelPrice.durationsHelp: Comma separated, e.g. 4,8,12. Leave empty for no limit. Models accept different clip lengths; once set, the studio offers only these options and the server rejects unsupported ones before submitting.
modelPrice.resolutionsHelp: Comma separated, e.g. 512P,768P,1080P. Leave empty for no limit. Once set, the studio offers only these and the film wizard uses the first one.
modelPrice.frameMatch: First frame must match output size
modelPrice.frameMatchOn: Crop the first frame before submitting
modelPrice.frameMatchHelp: Sora-family models require the first frame of an image-to-video job to match the output size exactly, otherwise the gateway returns "Inpaint image must match". When on, the server crops the first frame before submitting, at the cost of one extra image asset.
modelPrice.imageInputHelp: How image edits, reference images and masks are sent to the model. Inferred from the model name by default: gpt-image models use multipart upload (masks supported); seedream / qwen-image / gemini image pass image URLs in generations (no masks); others are treated as unsupported. Override here if the gateway docs disagree.
modelPrice.abilitiesHelp: AI actions on the canvas video toolbar pick models by ability: a button only becomes available once a model is tagged (e.g. tag Kling-3.0-Omni with Motion capture). Untagged models are inferred from their name (upscale / subtitle / vocal / matting / mocap …).
modelPrice.syncGatewayHelp: Fill durations / resolutions / ability tags from the gateway parameter table (only the Kling family exposes it today); empty fields only, manual values are kept
modelPrice.healthToggle: Click to switch between 7 and 30 days

audit.title: Usage logs
audit.description: Review login, feature usage, and admin operation records. Filter by user, category, action, and time.

system.title: Settings
system.description: Configure the site URL, login & registration, SMS verification, invoices, third-party sign-in, payments, the generation gateway, storage, and canvas media tools. Super admin only.
system.mediaActionsDesc: Turning an action off makes its canvas toolbar button unavailable. Empty means all on. Saved as MediaActionsDisabled (comma-separated lowercase action ids).
system.mediaQueueDesc: Global queue cap and per-user cap for queued plus in-progress jobs. Leave empty for the defaults (20 / 3); 0 or negative falls back to the default.
system.mediaBinDesc: Local crop, compress, and frame tools need ffmpeg / ffprobe on this host. Leave empty to use PATH.
system.mediaBinHelp: Absolute path, or leave empty for the command name on PATH.
system.mediaExtraKept: Unlisted disabled ids will be kept on save: {list}
system.mediaGroupAllOn: All actions in this group are on
system.mediaGroupPartial: Some actions in this group are off
system.mediaCoverageHint: The switch only hides the canvas button. Model post-process also needs a priced ability tag and a gateway model.
system.mediaGoPrice: Check abilities on the price list
system.mediaFfmpegOk: ffmpeg is available. Local crop / frames / transcribe can run.
system.mediaFfmpegMissing: ffmpeg is missing. Local tools and transcribe will stay unavailable.

mediaGap.disabled: Switch is off, hidden on the canvas
mediaGap.no_model: No priced model has this ability yet
mediaGap.not_on_gateway: Priced as {models}, but the gateway does not offer it

system.siteAddressDesc: Used to build WeChat login callbacks and Alipay / WeChat Pay notify URLs. Fields marked * are required.
system.loginDesc: Matches login/register toggles. Configure OAuth Client Id below before enabling OAuth.
system.emailVerify: Require email verification for password registration
system.siteUrlHelp: The public site root the API can reach. Do not include a trailing slash. Empty payment notify URLs are built from this address.
system.siteUrlInvalid: Enter a valid URL starting with http or https
system.featureDesc: Control studio feature entries. Disabled features are hidden on the user side.
system.director3dHelp: When off, the canvas no longer shows the 3D Director node. Visible by default if unset.
system.auditDesc: Records of sign-ins, key feature usage, admin operations and security events. View them under System → Usage logs.
system.auditRetentionHelp: Logs older than this are deleted daily; 0 keeps them forever. Defaults to 180 days if unset; changes apply at the next daily cleanup.
system.smsDesc: Used for phone-number login codes. When real sending is off, codes are printed to server logs for debugging. Fill in App ID, App Key, and the SMS project when enabling. Changes take effect immediately.
system.smsEnabledHelp: When off, codes are logged only and SubMail is not called. When on, messages are sent for real.
system.smsUrlHelp: SubMail API base URL. Default: https://api-v4.mysubmail.com.
system.smsUrlInvalid: Enter a valid URL starting with http or https
system.smsAppIdHelp: SubMail application ID. Required when real sending is on.
system.smsAppKeyHelp: SubMail application key; not echoed after save. Required when real sending is on.
system.smsAppKeyPh: Secrets are not shown in the frontend
system.smsSignTypeHelp: SubMail signature mode: md5 / sha1 / normal. Default md5.
system.smsProjectHelp: Created under SubMail > SMS > Projects. Template must include {'@'}var(code). Required when real sending is on.
system.invoiceDesc: Invoices are issued by the EasyAPI invoice platform, and e-invoices are sent to the email address the user provides. Fill in App Key and App Secret when enabling. Changes take effect immediately.
system.invoiceQuotaHint: Invoiceable amount = user's paid order amount (excluding manual top-ups and refunded orders) − amount already requested / invoiced.
system.invoiceEnabledHelp: When on, users see invoice management and can request invoices up to their invoiceable amount.
system.invoiceServiceUrlHelp: EasyAPI invoice platform service URL. Default: https://fapiao-api.easyapi.com.
system.invoiceServiceUrlInvalid: Enter a valid URL starting with http or https
system.invoiceAppKeyHelp: EasyAPI invoice service App Key; not echoed after save. Required when invoices are enabled.
system.invoiceAppSecretHelp: EasyAPI invoice service App Secret; server-side only and not echoed after save. Required when invoices are enabled.
system.invoiceTaxRateHelp: A decimal between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.01 means 1%. Set according to your company's tax scheme.
system.invoiceTaxRateInvalid: Tax rate must be a number between 0 and 1
system.invoiceItemNameHelp: Item name shown on the invoice. Default: 技术服务费 (technical service fee).
system.invoiceCategoryHelp: Used when the user does not choose an invoice type. Default: 全电电子普通发票 (fully digital general e-invoice).
system.wechatOauthHint: In WeChat Open Platform website apps, set the authorized callback domain to your API host; redirect_uri: {base}/wechat/oauth/callback
system.wechatOauthEnabledHelp: Allow WeChat QR login; create a website app on WeChat Open Platform and fill the fields below.
system.loadFail: Failed to load settings. Please try again later.
system.saveFail: Save failed. Please try again later.
system.fieldRequired: {field} is required when this provider is enabled
system.wechatAppIdHelp: AppId of the WeChat Open Platform website app.
system.wechatAppSecretPh: Secrets are not shown in the frontend
system.wechatAppSecretHelp: AppSecret of the WeChat Open Platform website app (not echoed after save).
system.wechatScopeHelp: For website WeChat login, use snsapi_login.
system.wechatRedirectHelp: Must match the authorized callback domain configured in WeChat Open Platform.
system.wechatRedirectRequired: Callback redirect_uri is required when this provider is enabled
system.wechatRedirectInvalid: Enter a valid callback URL starting with http or https
system.oidcDesc: Sign in with OIDC-compatible IdPs such as Google, Okta, and Auth0.
system.oidcHint: Set the home page URL to {base} and the redirect URL to {base}/oauth/oidc
system.oidcDiscoveryHint: If the provider supports a Discovery Endpoint, you can fill in only the Well-Known URL and the endpoints will be fetched automatically.
system.oidcClientSecretPh: Secrets are not shown in the frontend
system.githubDesc: Sign in and register with GitHub.
system.githubClientSecretPh: Secrets are not shown in the frontend
system.discordDesc: Sign in and register with Discord.
system.discordClientSecretPh: Secrets are not shown in the frontend
system.payAlipayDesc: Configure Alipay certificate-mode params. Face-to-face and PC website pay can be enabled separately. If the notify URL is empty, the site URL plus /alipay/webhook is used.
system.payAlipayHint: If the notify URL is empty, {base}/alipay/webhook is used. If the return URL is empty, {base}/console/recharge is used.
system.payAlipayEnabledHelp: Master switch. When off, both face-to-face and PC website pay are unavailable.
system.payAlipayF2fHelp: QR-code payment. Follows the master switch if not set.
system.payAlipayPcHelp: Redirect to the Alipay checkout. Requires the master switch.
system.payAlipayProductionHelp: When off, Alipay uses the sandbox gateway. Use sandbox App ID, private key, and certificates. Production by default if unset.
system.payAlipayAppIdHelp: From Alipay Open Platform after enabling face-to-face or PC website pay.
system.payAlipayPrivateKeyHelp: RSA2 app private key; not echoed after save.
system.payAlipayPublicKeyHelp: Alipay public key certificate (alipayCertPublicKey_RSA2.crt); not echoed after save.
system.payAlipayAppCertHelp: App public key certificate (appCertPublicKey.crt); not echoed after save.
system.payAlipayRootCertHelp: Alipay root certificate (alipayRootCert.crt); not echoed after save.
system.payAlipayNotifyUrlHelp: Alipay async notify URL; if empty, the site URL plus /alipay/webhook is used.
system.payAlipayReturnUrlHelp: Redirect after PC website pay; if empty, the site URL plus /console/recharge is used.
system.payWechatDesc: Configure WeChat Pay Native (APIv3) direct params.
system.payWechatHint: If the notify URL is empty, {base}/wechat/webhook is used
system.payWechatAppIdHelp: From the WeChat public platform after creating an app.
system.payMchPrivateKeyHelp: Merchant API private key (PEM); not echoed after save.
system.payApiV3Help: APIv3 key used to decrypt notifications; not echoed after save.
system.payWechatNotifyUrlHelp: WeChat Pay notify URL; if empty, the site URL plus /wechat/webhook is used.
system.paySecretPh: Leave empty to keep the current value
system.gatewayDesc: All canvas generation goes through this gateway. Changes apply immediately, no restart required.
system.gatewayEnabledHelp: When off, the model list is empty and the studio cannot start generation. Enabling without an API key still does not register the provider.
system.gatewayBaseUrlHelp: EasyAPI gateway root URL, without a trailing slash.
system.gatewayBaseUrlInvalid: Enter a valid URL starting with http or https
system.gatewayApiKeyHelp: From the gateway console. Not echoed after save; leave empty to keep the current value.
system.gatewayAccessTokenHelp: The system access token from the gateway console (Settings · Security); used to read the account balance and notify admins when it runs low. Not echoed after saving; leave blank to keep
system.gatewayUserIdHelp: User ID of the same gateway account as the access token (shown in the console profile)
system.gatewayAlertUsdHelp: Notify admins when the gateway balance falls below this amount. Enter 0 to turn the alert off. Default is 20.
system.gatewayAlertInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more. 0 turns the alert off.
system.gatewayMarkupRateHelp: Multiplier from gateway cost to suggested points. Default 3.
system.gatewayPointsRateHelp: Points per CNY. Default 20; keep it aligned with point packs.
system.gatewayUsdRateHelp: CNY per USD, default 7.3. Gateway prices are in USD; used when converting to suggested points.
system.gatewayPartnerDiscountHelp: Discount the gateway applies to this token, between 0 and 1, default 1 (no discount). See partner_discount in the gateway token usage log.
system.uploadBaseUrlHelp: Image-to-video assets must be publicly reachable. Leave empty to use this service /upload/.
system.qiniuDesc: Uploads go to Qiniu when Access Key and Secret Key are set. Otherwise local or Aliyun OSS is used.
system.qiniuDomainHelp: Public domain, including http or https.
system.qiniuKeyHelp: Not echoed after save; leave empty to keep the current value.
system.growthDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the default {value}
system.growthIntInvalid: Enter an integer of 0 or more

growthSectionDesc.signup: Points granted on sign-up; each onboarding task pays once when first completed.
growthSectionDesc.checkin: Days follow Asia/Shanghai; streak bonus every 7 days, full-month bonus, members get the multiplier.
growthSectionDesc.invite: Both sides are paid after the invitee's first video; first recharge rebates the inviter up to the cap. IP limits prevent abuse.
growthSectionDesc.bonus: Defaults used when creating bonus codes; each code can override them.
growthSectionDesc.promo: Countdown banner switch and link (end time comes from Plans → Promo); newly imported models get a launch price automatically.
growthSectionDesc.points: Rate used to turn yuan into points for rebates; keep it equal to the gateway panel's points per yuan.
growthSectionDesc.creator: Authors earn a share when their skill is called; share-open and off-site submissions award points by tier; compose watermark, screenplay prompt and model, plus transcription and storyboard models.
growthSectionDesc.lifecycle: Off by default. Once on, every 6 hours the system grants return gifts to long-inactive users and reminds members and users with expiring points — it really grants points and sends email, so turn it on only after checking the copy and numbers.

growth.GrowthSignupDailyIpLimit: Sign-ups per IP per day (0 = unlimited)

system.growthPlanModelHint: Leave empty to use the first active text model in model pricing
system.growthPlanPromptHint: Leave empty to use the built-in screenplay prompt. Changes apply to new compositions immediately.
system.growthPlanPromptPh: Leave empty for the built-in prompt
system.growthTranscribeHint: Preferred model for speech-to-subtitle. Must be a priced model tagged Transcribe; leave empty to pick by capability.
system.growthStoryboardHint: Preferred model for frame-by-frame analysis. Leave empty to use the vision text model, then auto-pick.
system.coverDesc: Frame-extraction methods available on this server. Read-only probe result.
system.coverFfmpegHint: Composing finished videos and last-frame continuation require ffmpeg on the server; without it canvas compose and Extend are unavailable (Alibaba Cloud OSS storage can still produce cover frames, but Extend still needs ffmpeg).
system.coverFontHint: Subtitles and watermarks additionally require a Chinese font on the server, otherwise Chinese text renders as blank boxes.
system.growthDefaultModelHint: Leave empty to use the first active model in the pricing table. When a model breaks on the gateway side, change this to switch the studio default without a release.
system.gatewayPricingBaseUrlHelp: Leave empty to use the gateway host. Set the console host (e.g. https://token.easyapi.com) when pricing lives on a different domain; otherwise model fetch returns no pricing or video resolutions.
system.growthVisionModelHint: Text model used for reverse prompting, smart recognition and storyboard analysis; must be an active text model that reads images (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, qwen3-vl-plus, glm-4.6v). Leave empty to pick automatically by model name
system.chatDesc: Chat switch, free policy, chat model and thinking options. Changes apply immediately, no restart required.
system.chatEnabledHelp: When off, the chat entry disappears for users (writes AgentEnabled).
system.chatFreeHelp: When on, chat tasks are not billed (writes ChatFreeEnabled); independent of the switch above.
system.chatModelHelp: Must be an active text model in the pricing table; leave it on Auto to pick automatically (screenplay model → first priced text model).
system.chatModelInvalid: This model is not in the priced text model list; use Auto to pick automatically
system.chatMaxTokensHelp: 0 means the parameter is not sent and the gateway default applies; maximum 32000.
system.chatThinkingModeHelp: "Default" sends no thinking parameter; On / Off send the thinking switch.
system.chatThinkingEffortHelp: Only models supporting reasoning effort (e.g. the GPT-5 family) honour this; "Default" sends nothing.
system.chatThinkingInvalid: Value is out of the allowed range
system.chatDailyFreeCountHelp: Free chats per user per day (days follow Asia/Shanghai); 0 means unlimited, members are not limited.
system.chatKnowledgeHelp: Extra platform knowledge (products, pricing, campaigns) sent with every chat; up to 8000 characters.
system.chatKnowledgePh: e.g. membership plans and points rules …
system.chatKnowledgeInvalid: Platform knowledge must be 8000 characters or fewer
system.chatSaveOk: AI chat settings saved and live

bonusCode.title: Bonus codes
bonusCode.description: Partner bonus codes: instant points, first-recharge bonus or membership days on claim; batch-generate, export, and see sign-ups and revenue per code. Super admin only.
bonusCode.emptyDesc: Click “New code” or “Batch generate” to create partner codes.
bonusCode.batchResult: Generated {count} codes — copy and keep them:
bonusCode.copyFail: Copy failed, select the text manually
bonusCode.prefixHelp: Optional, up to 20 chars; code = prefix + 6 random chars (ambiguous ones removed)
bonusCode.codeHelp: 3–32 chars, upper-cased on save; claims are case-insensitive
bonusCode.kindHelp: Display label only; a code may carry several benefits
bonusCode.benefitRequired: Fill at least one of points, first-recharge bonus, or membership days
bonusCode.groupRecharge: First-recharge bonus (paid after checkout by rate)
bonusCode.planCodeHelp: Plan used to open a trial for non-members; empty = only extend existing members
bonusCode.deleteHint: Codes that were already claimed are disabled instead of deleted.

ugc.title: UGC submissions
ugc.description: Review links users posted on Douyin / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili; award points by duration tier, doubled for viral posts.
ugc.likesInvalid: Likes must be a non-negative integer
ugc.toBannerHelp: On approval, create a home banner from the work cover
ugc.toBannerNoWork: No linked work; cannot add to carousel
ugc.remarkHelp: Required when rejecting; the submitter is notified

campaign.title: Campaigns
campaign.description: Create themed campaigns, configure prize tiers, review entries and settle rewards by likes ranking after the campaign ends.
campaign.emptyDesc: Create one from the top-right button.
campaign.tagHelp: Short label shown on the campaign card
campaign.settleHint: Only ended campaigns past their end time can be settled
campaign.slugHelp: Campaign page path; letters, digits and hyphens only
campaign.slugInvalid: Slug may contain only letters, digits and hyphens (1–64 chars)
campaign.rangeRequired: Please set start and end time
campaign.rangeInvalid: End time must be after start time
campaign.bannerUploadLabel: Click or drop to upload banner
campaign.bannerUploadDesc: Recommended 1200×400, jpg / png / webp / gif, up to 8MB
campaign.bannerTypeInvalid: Only jpg, png, webp, gif images are supported
campaign.rulesPh: Entry requirements, judging, rewards; line breaks supported
campaign.noPrize: No prizes configured; nothing is awarded on settlement.
campaign.prizeRankInvalid: Ranks start at 1 and "to" must be ≥ "from"
campaign.prizeEmpty: Each tier needs points or member days
campaign.modelPromoHelp: Applied to generation billing while the campaign is live. Use model + rate for one model (e.g. veo-3 at 50%), or models + rate for several; label is optional. Use points for a flat price.
campaign.modelPromoNeedModel: Each item needs model or models
campaign.modelPromoNeedDiscount: Each item needs rate (between 0 and 1) or points (≥1)
campaign.confirmDeleteBody: Delete "{title}"? Its entries will be removed too.
campaign.confirmSettleBody: Rank approved entries of "{title}" by likes snapshot and issue points / member days per prize tier.
campaign.settleHint2: Settlement is idempotent; the campaign becomes "Settled" afterwards.

partner.title: Channel partners
partner.description: Review MCN / school / KOL / developer partner applications, set rebate rates, and inspect attributed customers and accrued rebates.
partner.ratePh: Leave empty for the global default
partner.rateHelp: A decimal between 0 and 1; leave empty to use the global default rebate rate from system settings.
partner.rateInvalid: Rebate rate must be between 0 and 1
partner.remarkHelp: Optional, stored with the review record
partner.remarkRejectHelp: Required; the reason is sent to the applicant
partner.approveHint: On approval the backend generates a 6-character partner code and notifies the applicant.
partner.confirmDisableBody: Disable "{name}"? Its partner code stops working and no new rebates accrue.
partner.confirmDisableHint: Attributed customers and past rebate records are kept.

prompt.title: Prompt Library
prompt.description: What the public prompt library shows: entries added here, or pulled from remote sources every 12 hours.
prompt.emptyDesc: Add one manually, or configure a remote source above and sync.

style.title: Style library
style.description: What the studio's style library shows: a style is a name, a cover and a prompt fragment appended to the node prompt on generate.
style.emptyDesc: Click "New style" to add the first one.

team.title: Team quotas
team.description: See team seats and points used this month. Super admins can set a member's monthly limit when the owner is unreachable.
team.ownerPool: Uses the team pool. No monthly cap.
team.rootOnly: Only a super admin can change this here
team.membersHint: The owner or an admin sets member caps in the app. 0 means unlimited. Only a super admin can change them here.
team.limitHelp: Set the monthly points cap for {name}.
team.limitInvalid: Enter an integer from 0 to 10 million

subject.title: Subjects
subject.description: Characters, scenes and props saved by users. Super admins can remove a subject that breaks the rules.
subject.confirmDeleteBody: Delete “{name}”? It will be moved to the recycle bin.

withdraw.title: Withdrawals
withdraw.description: Review withdrawals from users and channel partners. Approval moves a request to paying; mark it paid with the processor transaction number. Rejection or a failed payout returns the balance.
withdraw.remarkPh: Required when rejecting, e.g. account details are wrong
withdraw.txnTooLong: The transaction number cannot exceed 64 characters
withdraw.approveHint: The status becomes paying. Mark it paid only after the money has gone out.
withdraw.rejectHint: Rejection returns the amount to the applicant. This cannot be undone.
withdraw.rejected: Rejected and the balance was returned
withdraw.partnerUserMissing: No user is linked to this partner
